subject.title: [Feature]: feat(session-memory): Add auto-trigger on idle, shutdown, and periodic checkpoints

question: Which lifecycle and privacy contract should OpenClaw support for automatic session-memory checkpoints beyond explicit /new and /reset commands?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent shape affects internal hooks, plugin-visible lifecycle events, shutdown deadlines, new config keys, and sensitive transcript retention, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary alone.

options.title: Stage Lifecycle Contract
options.body: Use or replace the daily/idle PR path first, then design shutdown, periodic checkpoint, and summary-output behavior as explicit opt-in surfaces with privacy and dedupe rules.

options.title: Narrow To Automatic Reset
options.body: Split shutdown, message-count, and LLM summary output into separate follow-ups and keep this tracker focused on idle/daily reset persistence.

options.title: Move To Plugin-Owned Memory
options.body: Define any missing generic plugin lifecycle API and let a memory plugin or ClawHub package own optional checkpointing behavior instead of expanding the bundled hook.

recommendation.title: Stage Lifecycle Contract
recommendation.body: Use or replace the daily/idle PR path first, then design shutdown, periodic checkpoint, and summary-output behavior as explicit opt-in surfaces with privacy and dedupe rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest current-line ownership signal on the bundled hook and docs, with recent adjacent fixes to session-memory responsiveness and filename behavior.
